podcast.body: An extremely rare 3-track, 7-inch vinyl single by The Upholsterers, with approximately 100 copies produced in the mid-1990s. Notably, these singles were concealed within couches and chairs that Jack and Brian were reupholstering, making them highly sought after by collectors with only two known copies found. "There were about 100 vinyl copies out there of a 3-track 7-inch called Your Furniture was always dead, I was just afraid to tell you."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was recorded by Jack Gillis (Jack White) and Brian Moldun, who called themselves The Upholsterers. It is estimated to be from the mid-1990s. "That record was called Makeers of High Grade Suites, and they build themselves, perhaps not surprisingly, as the Apulsterers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
